fields.cameraName: Main Server Room - Core Rack Area
fields.sceneBrief: High-angle CCTV view of the main server room, showing racks of servers and network equipment under cool white lighting. A lone figure in a gray NexGen Solutions jacket walks past the core rack (Rack 4), pausing briefly to insert a USB drive into a workstation labeled NCIA-ENROLL. The figure exits via the east door, leaving the frame.
fields.caption: Exported by Security Ops for incident IR-2026-031 — 4-week review, server room access log anomaly (11:47 PM, Oct 15, 2026)

instructorNote: This inject confirms the timeline of the insider threat. The 4-week-old video shows Volkov physically accessing the server room during his contract’s final week. If players request a deeper review of past footage, this is the evidence they need. If not, it confirms the absence of recent anomalies.
